{{Top|leg}}
A '''Vjun fox''' was a type of [[vulpine]] [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] native to [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. It had brindled red and cream fur and prehensile forepaws. One known Vjub fox was [[Miss Vix]], a [[Force familiar]] belonged to [[Viscountess]] [[Whirry Malreaux]].
